questions.q: The net work output of a heat engine is always _________.
options: Less than the amount of heat input
More than the amount of heat input
Less than the amount of heat output
questions.answer: Less than the amount of heat input

Perpetual motion machine of the third kind
Perpetual motion machine of the first kind
questions.answer: Perpetual motion machine of the first kind
